verdict.rationale: Reclaim 2.0 documents previewing calendar changes before deploying them, which loosely covers the 'review' part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows versioning or rollback of Habits, Tasks, Focus Time or other automation rules. Missing for 10: versioning or history of automation configurations, rollback or undo of automation changes, in-depth docs on the preview/review flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
